g.text: Decks you build and present with a persona. Each deck keeps its own chat.
Start a deck: give it a title, or describe it and Ada drafts the slides…
Revenue grew 18% against a plan of 12%, driven by…
Churn held steady; expansion did the work.
This is a deliberately long bullet so the shared
layout has to wrap it across more than one line
Underlined and coloured runs survive export.
This box is too small for the amount
of text that has been typed into it, so
the layout reports an overflow instead
The photo is 3:2; its frame is nearly square.
A crop rectangle in source fractions keeps
the sun and trims the red border on the left.
Start one above, or ask for a deck in
any chat: it shows up here too.
The server didn’t answer (502). Your decks

svg.text: The title field mirrors Docs. Enter or New
deck creates a deck with a title slide in
the chosen theme and opens the editor. If
the text reads as a description rather than
a title, it becomes Ada's first chat message
The card menu is a Radix dropdown and
keyboard reachable: Tab to the card, then ⋯
or Shift+F10. Rename edits the card title
inline. Duplicate makes “Copy of …” with new
IDs and shared images. Delete… asks for
Focus ring: 2px accent plus a 2px accent
halo at 35%. Arrow keys move between cards;
the grid becomes one column, and the theme
picker moves under the title field.
